source: The bus driver skipped my stop again.
target: The bus has passed my stop once more. The driver did not halt.

source: I left my headphones on the train this morning.
target: This morning, my headphones remained behind on the train.

source: Can you pick up some bread on your way back?
target: Will you claim some bread on your journey back?

source: The heater makes a strange noise at night.
target: At night, the heater speaks in a strange voice.

source: My sister is visiting us next weekend.
target: Next weekend, my sister shall arrive among us.

source: I forgot to reply to Anil's message yesterday.
target: Anil's message awaited my reply yesterday… and I forgot it.

source: The new manager wants weekly reports from everyone.
target: The new manager demands a report from every one of us, each week.

source: We ran out of sugar, so I made tea without it.
target: Our sugar is spent. I made the tea without it.

source: The kids are too excited to sleep tonight.
target: Excitement holds the children awake tonight. Sleep shall not come easily.

source: I can't decide between the red dress and the black one.
target: The red dress and the black one both call to me. I cannot choose.

source: Please lock the car when you get out.
target: When you leave the car, lock it behind you.

source: The parcel is stuck at customs for the third day.
target: For the third day, customs holds the parcel in its grip.

source: I'm nervous about my driving test tomorrow.
target: Tomorrow's driving test weighs upon my nerves.

source: The cafe on the corner closes at six.
target: The cafe on the corner shuts its doors at six.

source: Kiara won the spelling competition at school.
target: Kiara has triumphed in the school's spelling competition.

source: Did anyone see where I put my glasses?
target: Has anyone seen where my glasses were laid to rest?

source: I'll pay you back on Monday, I promise.
target: On Monday, I shall repay you. You have my word.

source: The power cut lasted almost two hours.
target: Darkness held us for nearly two hours. The power did not return sooner.

source: We should leave before the rain starts.
target: We should depart before the rain begins its descent.

source: My knee hurts whenever I climb the stairs.
target: The stairs exact a toll… my knee aches with every climb.

source: The printer is out of paper again.
target: Once more, the printer stands empty of paper.

source: Let's order dessert after the main course.
target: When the main course is done, let us summon dessert.

source: Rohit is moving to Pune next month.
target: Next month, Rohit shall make Pune his home.

source: I don't have enough change for the parking meter.
target: My coins fall short of what the parking meter demands.

source: The movie was longer than I expected.
target: The movie stretched on far longer than I foresaw.

source: Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
target: Will you guard my bag for a minute, if you would?

source: The plants on the balcony need more sunlight.
target: The plants on the balcony hunger for more sunlight.

source: I overslept and missed the first class.
target: Sleep held me too long. The first class began… without me.

source: The landlord says the rent goes up in April.
target: The landlord declares that in April, the rent shall rise.

source: I can't open the jar; the lid is stuck.
target: The jar refuses me. Its lid will not yield.

source: My phone screen cracked when I dropped it.
target: I dropped my phone, and its screen cracked beneath the fall.

source: We waited forty minutes for a table.
target: Forty minutes we endured before a table was granted to us.

source: The baby finally fell asleep after midnight.
target: After midnight, sleep at last claimed the baby.

source: Don't forget to switch off the geyser.
target: Do not forget to silence the geyser.

source: Meena has been coughing all week.
target: All week, a cough has troubled Meena.

source: The road to the village is flooded.
target: The waters have claimed the road to the village.

source: I think the milk has gone sour.
target: I believe the milk has turned sour.

source: Our flight lands at seven in the evening.
target: Our flight shall touch the earth at seven in the evening.

source: Is the pharmacy open on Sunday?
target: Does the pharmacy open its doors on Sunday?

source: The washing machine stopped halfway through the cycle.
target: Halfway through its cycle… the washing machine fell still.

source: I need a new charger; this one is loose.
target: This charger has grown loose. I require a new one.

source: The team lost the final by a single goal.
target: A single goal stood between the team and victory in the final. They lost.

source: Please remind Arjun about the dentist at four.
target: Remind Arjun that the dentist awaits him at four.

source: The neighbours are playing loud music again.
target: Once more, the neighbours fill the air with loud music.

source: My laptop takes forever to start up.
target: My laptop wakes with agonising slowness.

source: We have guests coming for dinner on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, guests shall join us for dinner.

source: The cashier forgot to give me my receipt.
target: My receipt never left the cashier's hand. It was forgotten.

source: I'm proud of how hard you worked this year.
target: This year, you laboured hard… and I am proud of it.

source: The lift is stuck between the third and fourth floors.
target: The lift hangs trapped between the third and fourth floors.

source: Can we split the taxi fare?
target: Shall we divide the taxi fare between us?

source: The cat knocked a glass off the table.
target: The cat has sent a glass tumbling from the table.

source: I haven't heard back from the bank yet.
target: The bank has not yet answered me.

source: Our internet bill went up by two hundred rupees.
target: The internet bill has risen by two hundred rupees.

source: Sana forgot her lunch box at home again.
target: Once more, Sana's lunch box remains at home, forgotten.

source: The traffic lights near the school aren't working.
target: The traffic lights near the school have fallen dark.

source: I'll finish the presentation tonight.
target: Tonight, the presentation shall be finished.

source: The fridge is making a buzzing sound.
target: The fridge has begun to buzz.

source: Please don't park in front of the gate.
target: Do not leave your vehicle before the gate, I ask you.

source: My grandmother turns ninety next month.
target: Next month, my grandmother shall reach ninety years.

source: The meeting ran an hour over time.
target: The meeting overstayed its hour… by a full hour more.

source: We need to book the hall before Friday.
target: The hall must be secured before Friday arrives.

source: I feel much better after a good night's sleep.
target: A good night's sleep has restored me. I am much better.

source: The tap in the kitchen won't stop dripping.
target: The kitchen tap drips without end. It will not be silenced.

source: Who finished the last of the coffee?
target: Who has claimed the last of the coffee?

source: The colours on this shirt faded after one wash.
target: One wash, and this shirt's colours have already faded.

source: I'm saving up for a new bicycle.
target: I gather my savings, coin by coin, for a new bicycle.

source: The school bus is running twenty minutes late.
target: The school bus is delayed by twenty minutes.

source: Your keys are on the kitchen counter.
target: Your keys rest upon the kitchen counter.

source: The match was cancelled because of the storm.
target: The storm has claimed the match. It is cancelled.

source: I accidentally sent the email before attaching the file.
target: The email departed before the file could join it. My error.

source: We're out of printer ink at the office.
target: The office's printer ink is spent.

source: Ishaan scored a century in yesterday's game.
target: In yesterday's game, Ishaan claimed a century.

source: The dentist said I need a filling.
target: The dentist has decreed that I require a filling.

source: Can you turn the fan on? It's stuffy in here.
target: The air here grows heavy. Will you set the fan in motion?

source: I left the umbrella at the restaurant.
target: The umbrella remains at the restaurant… where I left it.

source: The online class starts in five minutes.
target: In five minutes, the online class shall begin.

source: Our cook is on leave this week.
target: This week, our cook has taken leave.

source: I don't like the new office chairs.
target: The new office chairs do not please me.

source: The bridge is closed for repairs until June.
target: Until June, the bridge stands closed for repairs.

source: Let's take the stairs; the lift is too crowded.
target: The lift is overcrowded. Let us take the stairs.

source: My mobile data ran out in the middle of the call.
target: In the middle of the call, my mobile data ran dry.

source: The cake needs another ten minutes in the oven.
target: The cake requires ten minutes more within the oven's heat.

source: The water tank on the roof is leaking.
target: The water tank upon the roof is bleeding water.

source: I'm not sure the restaurant takes cards.
target: I am uncertain whether the restaurant accepts cards.

source: The cricket match starts at half past two.
target: The cricket match shall begin at half past two.

source: I got a parking ticket outside the mall.
target: Outside the mall, a parking ticket found me.

source: Please send me the bill by email.
target: Send the bill to me by email, if you would.

source: Our son starts college in August.
target: In August, our son shall begin his time at college.

source: The streetlight outside our house has been off for a week.
target: For a week, the streetlight outside our house has stood dark.

source: I need to renew my driving licence before it expires.
target: My driving licence must be renewed… before its time runs out.

source: The garden looks beautiful after the rain.
target: The rain has passed, and the garden stands beautiful in its wake.

source: Nobody has watered the plants since Tuesday.
target: Since Tuesday, no hand has watered the plants.

source: The train was so crowded I had to stand.
target: The train was so crowded that I was forced to stand.

source: Can I borrow your notes from yesterday's lecture?
target: May I borrow your notes from yesterday's lecture?

source: The air conditioner isn't cooling properly.
target: The air conditioner fails in its duty to cool.

source: I'll be working late, so don't wait up.
target: The work will hold me late. Do not wait for me… sleep.

source: The ATM ran out of cash.
target: The ATM has given its last note. It holds no cash.

source: My cousin is getting engaged in December.
target: In December, my cousin shall be engaged.

source: I can hear thunder in the distance.
target: Thunder speaks in the distance. I hear it.

source: We finally finished painting the bedroom.
target: At last, the bedroom is painted. Our work is done.
